4f9ecc1acf5ba56e0901.baseline: **US only** (not new users immediately). Domestic transactions except ACH direct debits settle next business day. Fee: **0.6% monthly** (prior month's accelerated charges, auto-debited). Limit: >$1M adds 1 extra day. Toggle on/off in payout settings. vs Instant Payouts: next-day is automatic/continuous (0.6%), Instant is manual/on-demand (within 30 min, higher fee). See [[source-stripe-payouts-next-day]].
4f9ecc1acf5ba56e0901.replacement: The November 2026 guide lists 24 Dashboard-user countries and directs platforms to their account team for connected-account access. Eligible domestic funds become available in the Stripe balance the next business day. On a daily automatic schedule Stripe sends eligible funds to the bank then, with receipt subject to bank timing. The guide gives regional exclusions and thresholds. May listed US-only Dashboard access and a 0.6% monthly fee. November retains a monthly assessment on the previous month’s accelerated charges and gives no percentage. Instant Payouts are on demand and charged per payout. See [[source-stripe-payouts-next-day]] and [[source-stripe-payouts-instant]].
4f9ecc1acf5ba56e0901.rationale: Kept the reviewed next-day regional and bank-receipt scope and the reviewed on-demand comparison. Do not infer a relative fee from historic rates.

a2a64c1d4e3064b2b92a.baseline: Available in 37 countries. Within 30 minutes, any time including weekends. Fee: **1%** (CA/EU/UK/SG/NO/HK/MY) or **1.5%** (US/AU/NZ/AE). Not compatible with multi-currency settlement. Daily limits: max 10/day, daily maximum amount, region-specific reset time. `instant_available` balance: fee pre-deducted, capped by daily limit, card funds immediate (ACH/SEPA only after settlement). Payout methods: debit card (most countries) or eligible bank account (US/GB/EU/SG/AU/HK). API: `method: 'instant'`.
a2a64c1d4e3064b2b92a.replacement: The May and November 2026 Dashboard guides list 36 account countries. For eligible accounts, funds typically settle within 30 minutes, including weekends. The May guide quoted **1%** (CA/EU/UK/SG/NO/HK/MY) or **1.5%** (US/AU/NZ/AE). The November guide retains the per-payout fee and pre-deduction without percentages. Multi-currency settlement is unsupported. Daily limits use request time and regional resets, with up to 10 payouts and a separate daily maximum amount. `instant_available` is capped by the remaining daily limit and includes eligible card funds after charge completion and ACH/SEPA after settlement. The destination table allows debit cards or eligible bank accounts in the US, GB, Euro Area, SE, DK, AU and SG, bank accounts only in HK, and debit cards only in the other listed destination row. Use `method: 'instant'` with an eligible `destination` for API requests. See [[source-stripe-payouts-instant#Institution and rail directory|the dated institution directory]] for country, rail and destination details.
a2a64c1d4e3064b2b92a.rationale: Uses the independently approved guide-level coverage and adds the directory-specific route. Keeps eligibility and exact institution support separate.
